subject: formal physical fleet-capacity scenario
observed: Every China81 instance currently exposes num_cv=num_ev=customer_count. These are algorithmic nonbinding ceilings rather than a plausible finite operating fleet.
expected: A versioned constructed-scenario rule sets finite CV/EV assets independently of treatment results and is tested for feasibility and sensitivity.
evidence: China81 instance.json and runtime bundle inventory
impact: E3 collaboration value, multi-trip reuse, E6 participation, and E7 dynamic feasibility can all be overstated when vehicles are effectively unlimited.
resolution: Decision D2 required before formal search.

subject: depot charger counts and power
observed: All depots use a uniform constructed value of two 22 kW chargers without a named-site contract.
expected: The paper labels the values as constructed scenario parameters, freezes a source/rationale, and preregisters a sensitivity panel.
evidence: China81 nodes.csv inventory; paper_main.tex parameter paragraph
impact: Charging congestion and the value of collaboration/charging optimization depend on scarce plugs and power.
resolution: Decision D2 required; do not present the values as observed facilities.

subject: rolling-stage initial-plan station preservation
observed: The stage filter rebuilt routes from customer ids only, removed public-station visits, retained charging actions, and silently replaced the now-invalid plan with a fuel-route fallback.
expected: Public-station nodes and bound actions survive active-customer filtering in original order.
impact: A valid E7 policy arm could be replaced by a different vehicle type and route, invalidating mechanism attribution.
resolution: Implementation repaired; physically consistent cross-stage charger fixture passes 19/19 tests.

subject: historical E5 source report under physical fleet caps
observed: The fixed-route report replays 22 fuel routes while the instance declares 10 fuel vehicles; all three diagnostic flips also exceed declared CV/EV limits. One naive charging replay additionally overlaps sessions for the same physical EV.
expected: Historical E5 evidence must be feasible under the current physical-vehicle and charging-session semantics before it supports any paper claim.
impact: Old E5 figures or mechanism conclusions cannot be reused as formal evidence.
resolution: Keep the historical test red and rerun E5 later from a valid finite-fleet E3/E4 solution; do not relax the checker.

subject: frozen PyVRP environment lacks bound SciPy/HiGHS
observed: The PyVRP 0.12.2 environment has NumPy and PyVRP but no SciPy package metadata; route-pool code can append /opt/anaconda3 site-packages at runtime.
expected: One locked environment contains Python, NumPy, PyVRP, SciPy/HiGHS and explicit single-thread controls, all recorded in metadata.
impact: The MIP backend and incumbent path depend on an ambient machine installation, preventing replay.
resolution: Build and hash one formal environment after D5; remove ambient site-packages fallback from the formal runner.

subject: repository regression suite has incompatible hard-coded environments
observed: Three tests require /opt/anaconda3/bin/python3.13 with NumPy 2.3.5, while the isolated audit environment uses Python 3.13.9 and NumPy 2.5.1.
expected: Environment-specific tests are selected explicitly and the general regression suite is portable or records an intentional skip.
impact: A red full suite can conflate reproducibility guards with implementation regressions.
resolution: Retain the failures in the audit ledger; define a formal environment matrix rather than weakening the guards.

subject: secrets and unsafe command execution in formal paths
observed: No credential assignment or private-key pattern was found in Python/JSON/TOML/YAML/env files. Formal/audit subprocess calls use argument lists; no shell=True, os.system, pickle.load, yaml.load, eval or exec was found in scoped paths.
expected: No embedded credentials and no shell-injection primitive in formal China runner/audit paths.
evidence: repository rg scans recorded in report
impact: No blocking security defect found in the audited paths.
resolution: Retain redacted/path-only secret scanning in release QA.
